args.subject: Group Booking Inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am inquiring about group booking availability for my party of 10 people in June. We are interested in staying at your hotel and would like to know about room options, rates, and any special group amenities.

Could you please provide information on availability for June dates, pricing, and the booking process for a group of this size?

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
